_meta.source: World Bank — World Food Security Outlook (microdata.worldbank.org/api/tables/data/fcv/wfso)
_meta.notes: Quarterly food-security outlook. Source covers 1999 onward; this file stores the 3 most recent observed rows per indicator plus flattened latest_* fields and the full baseline+downside projection block — the earlier history is dropped because no consumer reads it. Methodology: Andrée et al. (2020). Covered 191 countries × up to 8 indicators. Crisis-Affected Population numbers represent IPC/CH Phase 3+ populations (3-year centered average, smoothed).
